title: Sync trigger drops a destination row while source rows remain
description: Minimal fixture modelled on a defect published in GitLab MR !246505. A source table holds one row per access level; a trigger keeps a one-row-per-pair destination table in sync during a backfill.

requirements.text: If a synchronized user/project pair still has source rows, its destination row must exist.
assumptions: A source row present before the trigger and not yet backfilled is not yet synchronized, so its absence is not judged.
This is a minimal fixture, not GitLab's schema, services, locking or production workload.

variant_labels.corrected: the delete logic of GitLab's published fix; passing a test here is not a proof of safety
